existing.name: Sanchi Central Hotel
existing.issue: fabricated — 'Sanchi Central Hotel' described as Sanchi's most-established upscale heritage property with period rooms + MP cuisine is not verifiable on Tripadvisor, Booking, MMT for Sanchi village. Listicle ghost. Sanchi has no upscale heritage hotel — the village population is under 8,000 and the only formal mid-range accommodation is MPT Gateway Retreat.

replacement.name: MPT Gateway Retreat Sanchi

replacement.address: Vidisha-Bhopal Road, Sanchi, Raisen District 464661, Madhya Pradesh

existing.name: Ratnagiri Resort

existing.name: Lakshminarayan Temple Guesthouse (Sanchi Homestay Network)
existing.issue: fabricated — 'Lakshminarayan Temple Guesthouse' as a Sanchi pilgrim-trust accommodation network is not verifiable. The Maha Bodhi Society of India has a vihara at Sanchi (Chethiyagiri Vihara) which holds the relics for public display, but it does NOT operate paid guest-accommodation. Honest scarcity for Sanchi xfactor — the village has thin tourism infrastructure with no unique-stay alternative beyond MPT + 1-2 private hotels + the Bhopal base option (45 km).
